Anthroposphere Scientific Classes

This reference covers all 14 certificate-backed scientific classes in relic.scientific.anthroposphere: 11 executable concrete Functors, 3 fail-closed unavailable boundaries, and 0 abstract contracts. Each entry is generated from the live class, its IPHS certificate, State Contract Model, and ParameterManager metadata. Fail-closed unavailable classes are not instantiated during documentation generation.

The tables distinguish constructor controls, runtime variables, and ParameterManager scientific parameters. Values shown as package defaults belong to the documented RELIC architecture version and must not be copied as hardcoded constants into scientific code.

Certificate wildcard parameter groups (*, <pft>) are expanded to their exact current YAML entries. Every other declared parameter is matched to the parameter database by its exact full key; a declared name is never mapped to a key that merely ends with the same name.

Exact ParameterManager rows report the live YAML value, bounds, gradient policy, description, and provenance. A row whose value reads not declared in the parameter database is intentionally not assigned an invented default: the class metadata or certificate declares the quantity, with the meaning and units it states, but the parameter database has no key of that exact name.

IPHS levels are read from the sole certificate owner. Levels 1 to 3 describe compatibility, wrapping, or declared structure; they are not strict IPHS/GENERIC claims.

The Channel column of each runtime output contract applies relic.core.state.types.partition_outputs, the only runtime output channel classifier, to the declared output name. A name that the classifier reserves for diagnostics, such as diagnostics.*, goes to the diagnostics channel and is never committed as state. For any other name the channel is decided at run time by the write mode of the returned value: StateWriteMode.DERIVED routes the output to the diagnostics channel, and any other write mode sends it to the StateManager commit (a value without a write mode takes the run’s semantic-mode rules or the StateManager schema). The generator does not run forward(), so it does not predict that write mode. The Kind column is the State Contract Model kind of the variable and does not set its channel.

Governing equations and canonical operator

Literature or process form

Emissions preprocessing splits already computed inventory mass fluxes using declared sector priors and spatial surrogates while preserving species totals.

Canonical RELIC structural form

Level 1 compatibility records the executed allocation \(E_{s,k,x} = W_{s,k,x} E_{k,x}\) with \(W_{s,k,x} \geq 0\) and \(\sum_{s} W_{s,k,x} = 1\); no IPHS operator is claimed.

Entry

Meaning

allocation_rule

forward evaluates the pointwise non-negative W_sector_species_proxy and normalizes it only along the sector axis

sector_aggregation

Governing equations and canonical operator

Literature or process form

CMAQ/SMOKE-style emissions preprocessing applies sector-specific speciation before chemistry transport and keeps gas molar flux separate from aerosol mass flux.

Canonical RELIC structural form

\[ F_{\mathrm{gas},\mathrm{mol}} = \star_{\mathrm{MW},\mathrm{inv}} S_{\mathrm{gas}} F_{\mathrm{sector}}; F_{\mathrm{aer},\mathrm{mass}} = S_{\mathrm{aer}} F_{\mathrm{sector}} . \]

Entry

Meaning

S_gas

forward applies sector-specific VOC and NOx split operators to fixed gas axes

S_aer

forward applies sector-specific PM composition to the fixed aerosol axis

star_MW_inv

build_hodge_contract positive molecular-weight inverse Hodge

O_h

numeric conservation and inventory-basis diagnostics returned by forward

State advancement, conservation, and open boundaries

Entry

Meaning

potential_basis

sector-resolved inventory mass-flux cochain \(u_{\mathrm{sector}}\)

effort_variable

fixed CB05 maps \(S_{\mathrm{gas}}\) and \(S_{\mathrm{aer}}\) plus molecular Hodge star_MW_inv

state_advancer

\(F_{\mathrm{gas},\mathrm{mol}} = \star_{\mathrm{MW},\mathrm{inv}} S_{\mathrm{gas}} u_{\mathrm{sector}}\); \(F_{\mathrm{aer},\mathrm{mass}} = S_{\mathrm{aer}} u_{\mathrm{sector}}\)

runtime_usage

28.01; bounds=(28.01, 28.01)

fixed

Conventional bulk molar mass of carbon monoxide (CO), the sum of the CIAAW 2024 abridged standard atomic weights C = 12.011 and O = 15.999; a fixed model constant, not an isotopologue-specific mass; the fixed bounds select this convention and do not assert zero natural isotopic variability

Governing equations and canonical operator

Literature or process form

Land-surface models preserve sub-grid land units or tiles and aggregate supported grid-cell diagnostics or exchanges using land-cover fractions.

Canonical RELIC structural form

\(y = O_{\mathrm{land}} ( f , \theta )\), where \(O_{\mathrm{land}}\) is a read-only mixed-unit observation map.

Entry

Meaning

O_land

calculate_weighted_parameters read-only area-weighted observation map

R_query

externally bound typed source-to-target field chain map

G_gradient

externally bound typed source-field gradient map

O_h

canonical runtime diagnostic output

State advancement, conservation, and open boundaries

Entry

Meaning

potential_basis

none; the process is a read-only observation

effort_variable

not_applicable_read_only_observation_has_no_thermodynamic_effort

state_advancer

\(y_{h} = O_{\mathrm{land}} ( f_{h} , \theta ) \mathrm{without} \mathrm{prognostic} \mathrm{state} \mathrm{advancement}\)

runtime_usage

forward evaluates \(O_{\mathrm{land}}\) once and returns REPLACE diagnostics without prognostic ownership.

Governing equations and canonical operator

Literature or process form

A row-sum-zero continuous-time Markov generator preserves total land-use fraction under its matrix exponential.

Canonical RELIC structural form

\[ \dot{p} = p Q ( \theta ); p ( t + \mathrm{d}t ) = p \exp ( Q ( \theta ) \mathrm{d}t_{\mathrm{years}} ); Q 1 = 0 . \]

Entry

Meaning

Q

Row-sum-zero CTMC generator built by _build_ctmc_generator and _compute_transition_matrix.

exp_Q_dt

\(\mathtt{torch.matrix\_exp} ( Q \cdot \mathrm{d}t_{\mathrm{years}} )\) transition map.

H_Q

Positive exit-rate Hodge from build_hodge_contract.

R_h

Externally bound fine-to-coarse typed chain map.

P_h

Externally bound coarse-to-fine typed chain map.

O_h

Namespaced observation outputs.

State advancement, conservation, and open boundaries

Entry

Meaning

potential_basis

Land-use fraction state cochain \(p_{h}\).

effort_variable

CTMC generator \(Q_{h}\) and mobility audit \(H_{Q}\).

state_advancer

\(p ( t + \mathrm{d}t ) = p ( t ) \exp ( Q_{h} \mathrm{d}t_{\mathrm{years}} ) .\)

runtime_usage

forward evaluates one matrix exponential and returns one full-state replacement.

Governing equations and canonical operator

Literature or process form

Multi-objective farm management uses configurable priorities and resource constraints; retained coefficients are calibratable policy heuristics rather than universal laws.

Canonical RELIC structural form

\(q_{i} = w_{i} ( 1 + s_{i} )\); \(p_{i} = q_{i} / \sum_{j} ( q_{j} )\); \(H_{m} = \operatorname{diag} ( w_{i} / \sum_{j} ( w_{j} ) )\); \(0 \leq U_{r} \leq Q_{r}\) for each resource r.

Entry

Meaning

Pi_h

ParameterManager-backed priority projection from canonical state inputs.

H_m

Positive-semidefinite diagonal priority Hodge metric with non-negative weights and positive total.

G_m

Typed management coordination control port.

resource_normalization

\(c = \sum_{r} R_{r} / Q_{r}\) is dimensionless because each requirement and quota pair has the same unit.

state_advance

No prognostic state advance is owned by this observer/controller.

State advancement, conservation, and open boundaries

Entry

Meaning

potential_basis

Five-component management-priority observation basis.

effort_variable

Normalized priority vector and per-resource quota-normalized scheduling score.

state_advancer

No prognostic state advance; forward returns explicit UpdateItem(REPLACE, \(\mathrm{per}_{\mathrm{timestep}} = \mathrm{False} ) \mathrm{observations}\) and next-step controls.

runtime_usage

The simulator commits eight public ports; current diagnostic routing keeps twelve namespaced diagnostics ephemeral.

Governing equations and canonical operator

Literature or process form

Delta M_q equals the sum over scheduled product mass times elemental mass fraction times exact timestep overlap divided by event duration, where q is N or P.

Canonical RELIC structural form

\(y_{h} = G_{h} u_{h}\) for declared nitrogen and phosphorus managed-boundary ports.

Entry

Meaning

G_N

managed nitrogen input incidence from scheduled product mass to the nitrogen boundary flow

G_P

managed phosphorus input incidence from scheduled product mass to the phosphorus boundary flow

J_h

not declared because management application is not a reversible internal process

M_h

not declared because management application is not a dissipative internal process

N_h

not declared because nutrient transformations are owned by pedosphere reaction Functors

State advancement, conservation, and open boundaries

Entry

Meaning

potential_basis

No storage potential is claimed; the module maps an external managed event to typed boundary flows.

effort_variable

Scheduled product mass and composition define the managed boundary input.

state_advancer

\(y_{h} = G_{h} u_{h}\) through the declared nitrogen and phosphorus managed-matter ports.

runtime_usage

FertilizationManagement.forward computes exact event overlap, elemental boundary mass, boundary flux, and the phosphorus StateManager increment once.

Governing equations and canonical operator

Literature or process form

Biomass burning emissions are represented by fuel burned times species emission factors with moisture, combustion completeness, and suppression controls.

Canonical RELIC structural form

\(\dot{x} = N_{h} r_{h} ( x_{h} , \theta ) + G_{h} u_{\mathrm{fire}}\), with \(r_{h} \coloneqq r_{\mathrm{fire}}\); \(H_{\mathrm{fire}} = \operatorname{diag} ( w_{i} / \sum_{j} w_{j} )\), \(w_{i} \geq 0 .\)

Entry

Meaning

N_h

stoichiometric map from fuel combustion to atmospheric species and ash outputs

r_h

ParameterManager-backed combustion, emission-factor, ash, and carbon-loss rate tensor passed to advance_reaction_network

H_fire

PSD combustion mobility built by build_hodge_contract

G_h

fire_combustion_management_port ignition and suppression input map

O_h

canonical runtime diagnostic output

State advancement, conservation, and open boundaries

Entry

Meaning

potential_basis

\(G_{\mathrm{fire}} ( x_{h} ) = 0.5 \cdot x_{h}^{\mathsf{T}} \cdot H_{\mathrm{fire}} \cdot x_{h}\) for combustible fuel storage and open emission ports

effort_variable

\(\mu_{\mathrm{fire}} = \frac{\mathrm{d}G_{\mathrm{fire}}}{\mathrm{d}x_{h}}\); combustion completeness, fuel moisture, and emission factors define \(r_{h}\) entries

state_advancer

forward evaluates explicit \(\dot{x} = N_{h} r_{h}\) through advance_reaction_network in fire combustion output assembly

runtime_usage

_assemble_fire_reaction_outputs calls advance_reaction_network with declared \(N_{h}\) and \(r_{h}\) for combustion, emissions, ash, and carbon loss

explicit_stoichiometric_usage

_assemble_fire_reaction_outputs materializes stoichiometric_N and rates, then lowers \(\dot{x} = N_{h} r_{h}\) through advance_reaction_network.

event_support

each calendar occurrence executes once; \(r_{h}\) rates are the event-integrated masses divided by the executing step dt (\(\Delta_{t,\mathrm{event}} = \mathrm{d}t , \mathrm{reported} \mathrm{as} \mathtt{diagnostics.fire.event\_support\_seconds} )\), so rate * dt returns the event mass for hourly, daily and multi-day steps

Governing equations and canonical operator

Literature or process form

Livestock grazing intake depends on body weight, stocking density, forage quality, and biomass availability; intake carbon and nitrogen are partitioned among excreta and managed livestock exports.

Canonical RELIC structural form

\(\dot{x} = N_{h} r_{h} ( x_{h} , \theta ) + G_{h} u_{\mathrm{grazing}}\), with \(r_{h} \coloneqq r_{\mathrm{grazing}}\); \(H_{\mathrm{grazing}} = \operatorname{diag} ( w_{i} / \sum_{j} w_{j} )\), \(w_{i} \geq 0 .\)

Entry

Meaning

N_h

non-strict open-port map from biomass removal to carbon, nitrogen, excreta, livestock export, and trampling channels

r_h

ParameterManager-backed grazing intake, excreta return, livestock export, and trampling rate tensor passed to advance_reaction_network

H_grazing

PSD removal-return mobility built by build_hodge_contract

G_h

grazing_biomass_return_port stocking input map

O_h

canonical runtime and biomass-balance diagnostics

State advancement, conservation, and open boundaries

Entry

Meaning

potential_basis

\(G_{\mathrm{grazing}} ( x_{h} ) = 0.5 \cdot x_{h}^{\mathsf{T}} \cdot H_{\mathrm{grazing}} \cdot x_{h}\) for grazable biomass and return ports

effort_variable

\(\mu_{\mathrm{grazing}} = \frac{\mathrm{d}G_{\mathrm{grazing}}}{\mathrm{d}x_{h}}\); stocking pressure, forage quality, and livestock traits define \(r_{h}\) entries

state_advancer

forward evaluates explicit \(\dot{x} = N_{h} r_{h}\) through advance_reaction_network in grazing biomass-return output assembly

runtime_usage

_assemble_grazing_reaction_outputs calls advance_reaction_network with declared \(N_{h}\) and \(r_{h}\) for intake, dung, urine, livestock export, and trampling ports

explicit_stoichiometric_usage

_assemble_grazing_reaction_outputs materializes stoichiometric_N and rates, then lowers \(\dot{x} = N_{h} r_{h}\) through advance_reaction_network.

Governing equations and canonical operator

Literature or process form

Harvested biomass follows harvest-index partitioning, while crop residues and root turnover return carbon and nitrogen to managed soil pools.

Canonical RELIC structural form

The current Level 3 implementation is a typed open-port partition map. The quadratic quantity \(Q_{h} = 0.5 \cdot x_{h}^{\mathsf{T}} \cdot H_{h} \cdot x_{h}\) is diagnostic only; no dissipative pH or GENERIC state equation is claimed.

Entry

Meaning

H_harvest

positive semidefinite diagnostic metric assembled by build_hodge_contract; it is not a GENERIC mobility or a dissipative pH resistance operator

M_h

empirical non-negative partition weights \(M_{h}\)(\(u_{h}, \theta\)); the symbol does not denote the GENERIC entropy-production operator

G_h

open harvest_biomass_residue_port control and export map

O_h

quadratic-potential, effort-norm, ledger-residual, and runtime diagnostics

State advancement, conservation, and open boundaries

Entry

Meaning

potential_basis

\(Q_{h} ( x_{h} ) = 0.5 \cdot x_{h}^{\mathsf{T}} \cdot H_{\mathrm{harvest}} \cdot x_{h}\) is a diagnostic quadratic quantity, not a Hamiltonian or thermodynamic potential claim

effort_variable

\(q_{h} = \frac{\mathrm{d}Q_{h}}{\mathrm{d}x_{h}} = H_{\mathrm{harvest}} \cdot x_{h}\) is a diagnostic gradient, not a dPH or GENERIC conjugate effort claim

state_advancer

the Level 3 typed open-port map partitions biomass into managed export and residue-return outputs; it is not asserted to equal (J-R)\(e_{H}\) or J \(e_{E}\)+M \(e_{S}\)

runtime_usage

forward evaluates _canonical_iphs_harvest_partition for each scheduled event and _storage_potential for the potential audit; Level 4 or Level 5 thermodynamic closure is not claimed.

Governing equations and canonical operator

Literature or process form

\(D_{\mathrm{tillage}} = k_{\mathrm{disturbance}} I f_{\theta}\); \(R_{\mathrm{inc}} = \operatorname{clamp} ( k_{\mathrm{residue}} I ( a_{\theta} + f_{\mathrm{moisture}} ) , 0 , 1 )\); \(F_{C} = C_{\mathrm{soil}} f_{\mathrm{0}} f_{p} I D f_{T} / S_{\mathrm{day}} \mathrm{in} \mathrm{an} \mathrm{operation} \mathrm{step}\), 0 otherwise.

Canonical RELIC structural form

\(\dot{y} = G_{h} u_{h}\) through the declared tillage disturbance, residue, porosity, roughness, and carbon-export ports.

declared port map
